messages:
chris: Need a quick alignment thread. Product wants a normalized "cost per 1k tokens" card in the console. We need runtime + infra telemetry inputs and an ingest contract. Who can own what?

maya: I can lead runtime telemetry. High-level: emit per-request counters (tokens_out, cache_hits, batch_savings) plus small context tags. Prefer events small and immutable.

ishita: Platform side: we need to settle cardinality rules. If we include route and customer ids, ingestion cost explodes. Suggest route_hash + route_bucket and strict tag whitelist.

jared: Product: card should show: normalized $/1k tokens, stacked savings (cache, batch), and breakouts by model and deployment_tier. Also want canary vs baseline comparison for rollouts.

tina: Infra: we'll provide instance SKU -> $/ms registry. Runtime should send compute_ms and gpu_seconds so we can multiply. We'll version the registry schema and provide TTL.

maya: Runtime will emit compute_ms and a lightweight model_tag. Also want sequence_length_bucket (short/med/long) for cost curves.

ishita: Ingestion contract proposal: two payloads: 1) request_summary (required): integer counters; 2) optional sampled_detail for debugging. Keep request_summary minimal to reduce cardinality. Example: 

```
{
  "event": "request_summary",
  "tokens_out": 412,
  "cache_hit_tokens": 128,
  "batch_saved_tokens": 56,
  "model": "rw-v3-13b",
  "deployment_tier": "dedicated",
  "route_hash": "rk_9a2f",
  "seq_bucket": "short",
  "compute_ms": 42
}
```

jared: UX: include toggle: on-demand vs reserved pricing. Also allow customers to override their committed price to preview real spend.

chris: How do we compute $/1k? Options: a) compute_ms -> $ using registry multipliers, then divide by tokens -> scale to 1k; b) use a token-unit price table. I prefer formula (a) to keep it linked to actual infra cost.

tina: Registry will expose SKU multipliers as $/ms and GPU $/s. We'll include quantization multipliers per quantize_profile. If registry is unavailable, dashboard should use last-known or default fallback.

maya: Agree. Runtime will NOT compute $ itself; send raw ms/counters. Keeps formula changes out of runtime.

ishita: Platform will implement pre-aggregation windows: ingest will de-dupe bursts and emit 10s pre-agg, then we roll to 1m, 1h, 1d in storage. Realtime card reads 1m.

tina: We'll add adaptive sampling on high-card keys and reservoir sampling for sampled_detail. We'll also enforce a max of 100k unique route_hashes per org per day; beyond that we collapse into "route_other".

maya: Add optional tag cache_kind: prefix|kv|none so the UI can break down cache savings by mechanism. Keep it low-card.

jared: For rollouts, include optional cohort_tag on events. Platform to limit active cohorts to 20 and sample cohort events if cardinality spikes. UI will show cohort vs baseline side-by-side.

chris: Agreed deliverables: runtime telemetry PR, platform ingest proto, infra registry stub, product wireframes. Also need retention/aggregation SLAs. Proposed: 1m windows kept for 30 days, 1h for 90 days, 1d for 2 years.

ishita: We'll validate the proto strictly. Keep counters as integers to avoid float drift. Ingest shim will emit a hashed route and a route_bucket for UI-friendly grouping.

maya: I'll open a telemetry draft with sample SDK shims to translate internal counters to the public schema.

tina: Infra PR will include registry schema: version, sku, $/ms, gpu-$-per-s, quantize_multiplier, ttl. Also include health endpoint and last-modified header.

jared: Wireframes link incoming. Main card will normalize to 1k tokens, show absolute $/1k and a waterfall for savings, plus a dropdown to split by model/deployment/route_bucket/sequence_bucket.

chris: timeline: PRs by Thu EOD; sync Fri 11am to sign off. I'll open a tracking issue. @schema-bot can you create it?

schema-bot: created issue RW-5810: "Cost per 1k tokens dashboard - telemetry + ingest contract" <https://infra/repo/issues/5810>

maya: Telemetry PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/1178 (draft schema + SDK shim)

ishita: Ingest proto: https://git.redwood/platform/pull/729 (proto + validation tests)

tina: Registry stub PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/112 (schema + health endpoints)

jared: Wireframes: https://figma.com/file/efgh5678/cost-1k-wf

chris: Thanks all. Final ask: platform, add a small sample dataset (1h) generation script so product can prototype the UI with realistic numbers. Platform to drop link in thread. Meeting Fri unless anything blocks. :thumbsup:
